headline: Changi Airport Baggage Handling Draws Local Interest Amid Hiring Challenges
summary: Changi Airport baggage handling jobs are attracting local interest, but hiring remains difficult as migrant worker advocacy groups urge scrutiny on work pass applications.
why: Labor availability and recruitment dynamics in aviation logistics impact operational efficiency and cost structures for major transport hubs.
